label: +0.1 cm (Both Sides)
description: A 1mm padding addition is essentially imperceptible to the naked eye but just enough to square the shoulder point by a fraction and prevent any slight hollowing that occurs when a jacket hangs without support at the sleeve head. It is the preference of tailors who value the natural Italian look but wish to provide a tiny insurance against an imperfect shoulder line, creating a finish that photographs as clean and natural but sits slightly more defined in person. This is the most subtle intervention in the spectrum of shoulder construction — barely there, simply ensuring the garment has an impeccable, defined edge.
